constraints: This increment is BK-001 only. Do not implement BK-002.
The form of BK-001 FR-3 is a later slice: write no UI.
Field hypotheses are not software test gates.

`tests/` cannot import `bookshelf/internal/...` (Go internal rule): acceptance tests in `tests/` drive the built service over HTTP; tests that need internal packages live beside them as package tests.
`go test` runs each package in its own directory: inside `tests/`, the repository root is `..`, never `tests/...` or `bookshelf/...` relative to the working directory.

acceptance.text: AC-1 GIVEN an empty shelf, WHEN `Sample Book` by `Sample Author` is added through [[TA:API-01]], THEN the response is `201` and the listing of [[TA:API-03]] shows one unread book.
AC-2 GIVEN a shelf with two books, WHEN a third is added, THEN it is listed last ([[TA:ALG-01.2]]).
AC-3 GIVEN an empty title, WHEN a book is added through [[TA:API-01]], THEN the shelf is unchanged and the error message is „Der Titel fehlt oder ist zu lang.“ ([[UX:W-MC-03]]).
A reader adds a book in under ten seconds — a field hypothesis, measured with readers, not a CI gate for BK-001.

tasks.title: Author failing tests from BK-001 AC-1…AC-3 only

BK-001 slice 1 of 2, red first — the acceptance tests of the service (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3), not the code. `TestBK001AC1`: adding `Sample Book` by `Sample Author` answers `201` and the listing shows one unread book. `TestBK001AC2`: a third book is listed last. `TestBK001AC3`: an empty title is refused with `400 ERR_TITLE`, its message is the text of W-MC-03, and the shelf is unchanged. Each test builds the service once (`go build -o <temp dir>/bookshelf<exe> bookshelf/cmd/bookshelf`, `<exe>` = `.exe` when `runtime.GOOS` is windows; `go test` runs inside `tests/`), starts it with `--addr 127.0.0.1:<free port>` and `--db <temp file>` and talks to it over HTTP; it fails with the build output while the service does not build. Plain `testing` and the standard library only. The next task writes the code and cannot change these tests.

BK-001 slice 1 of 2 — the code: `tests/bk001ac1_test.go`, `tests/bk001ac2_test.go` and `tests/bk001ac3_test.go` are written and read-only — make them pass. Write `bookshelf/cmd/bookshelf` and `bookshelf/internal/shelf` after TA §3, API-01, API-03, TBL-01 and ALG-01. Standard library and `modernc.org/sqlite` only; the module files are the engine's, not the worker's.
QR from requirement → test → run evidence; keep the field row open
